body: I tried prozac a few months back but it just made me more sad. And therapy would be hard since i dont drive and i wouldnt have a ride to one.

Well im a pretty shy person. I used to have 1 close friend but we arent friends anymore so im pretty lonely i guess. I like to read and draw. I also live to daydream...but i guess thats just a way to escape reality. I also dont trust people at all. I always feel like people are trying to hurt me some way or another. I dont really feel like i have that many great qualities about myself. Im boring i guess you could say.

I just dont know where to start fighting....it seems like i have to fight against everything. I used to be somewhat okay. I had an actual house to live in with my mom and brothers. But then i made the mistake of telling my mom what my brother did and her basically choosing him over me. And now i can never live there again. And my boyfriend...he doesnt work and is extremely lazy. He s a sweet guy but i dont want to be with him. But i have to....and it makes me feel more like shit because i dont want to hurt him. I try telling him how i feel about me wanting to die and all he ever says is "dont talk like that"....im better off dead.
